stop_reason: Existing key successfully verifies current credits and usage, but responses do not expose Auto Recharge status or its active threshold. Paid admission paused, no account/key settings changed. Need read-only confirmation off or a verified threshold/safe local stop floor.
historical_accounting: Preserved separately; superseded forecasts and inactive allocations are not new charges against the explicitly funded run.
recovery_caveat: MemOS13 and Supermemory1 graded answers retained. First scored resume attempts made no paid calls and failed an inappropriate pre-answer empty-session assertion. A focused helper fix now preserves scored sessions and their cwd; native resumed execution remains unverified while paid admission is paused. The failed helper overwrote the pre-recall isolation metadata; retained turn evidence is unchanged, and original witness recovery remains an audit caveat.
mem0_recovery: Original19 grades retained; a later partial Oct10 ingest makes the existing store unsafe for the earlier ungraded visit-mid checkpoint. No fresh rerun started.
